method: DC nodal calculation from KCL; no SPICE transistor model or hardware test
assumptions: Pin inserted opens the contact; pin removed closes it. Physical switch is not identified.
Nominal 3S input: 8.1–12.6V; existing UVLO governs usable low voltage.
Gate current +/-10uA is the conservative 20V, Tj=25C table value; high-temperature gate leakage is not bounded by that row.
limits: No guaranteed RDS at VGS=2.5V and hot junction is provided; large DC margin does not replace a temperature test.
No contact-bounce, hot-plug, ESD, CM5 shutdown or thermal behavior is simulated.
Startup/off and switch continuity require a bench test.
